items.html: *In it we shall explain the matter of birth, how its matter is. Behold, it was explained above the matter of the three chambers that there are in the woman, and how in the last three months, the entire fetus in its three aspects — which are vessels, sparks, and lights — all rise to the upper chamber. And behold, when the time of birth arrives, when the fetus is already complete in the three aforementioned aspects, it rolls and descends to the lower chamber, and afterward comes out even from that lower chamber, and then it is born.
